{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
dupes = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

dupes_count = len(dupes)
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {dupes_count}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {missing_baseline}')

# Check assay_batch values
print(f'Assay batches: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Check if any batch-B values are present
batch_b_count = (df['assay_batch'] == 'B').sum()
print(f'Number of batch-B samples: {batch_b_count}')"}
